resources.string: This build cannot update itself; only released versions can.

Whenever the app is opened or the network returns, every half hour while it is open, and every twelve hours otherwise, on any connection. This asks GitHub for Lattice\'s releases; nothing about you is sent with it.

Download an update as soon as it is found and install it right away, without asking. Lattice closes while it is replaced; it waits for a call to end first. With this off, Lattice asks when it is opened.
Download automatically over metered connections too. An update is about 125 MB. A download you start yourself uses any connection.
Versions that are published for testing.
Android wants your permission once, under “Install unknown apps”.
Not checked since the app started.
Installing. Lattice closes while it is replaced.
Android asks you to confirm the update.
On mobile data the automatic download waits for Wi-Fi. “Download and install” starts it now.

A download is installed only if it matches the checksum of the release and is signed with the same key as this app. For the first update, Android asks you to allow Lattice to install apps and may ask you to confirm; on Android 12 or newer, later updates install without a question. Lattice closes while it is replaced; Android does not let it open itself again, so a notification tells you when it is done, and a tap on it opens the app.
Update now? Lattice closes while it is replaced; a notification tells you when it is done.
Update now? The download is about 125 MB and you are on mobile data. Lattice closes while it is replaced; a notification tells you when it is done.
Android first wants your permission for Lattice to install apps, once, under “Install unknown apps”. Come back here afterwards.
Installing Lattice %1$s. The app closes now.
Android asks you to confirm the update.
Could not reach GitHub. Check the connection and try again.
The release on GitHub is incomplete or inconsistent. Try again later.
Not enough free storage. An update needs about 500 MB.
The download is damaged or is not the released file. It was deleted; try again.
Android cannot read the downloaded file. It was deleted.
The downloaded file is not the announced version of Lattice. It was deleted.
The downloaded file is not signed with the key of this app, so it was not installed.
The signature of the download or of this app could not be read, so nothing was installed.
Lattice is not allowed to install apps yet.
Android blocked the update. A device policy, Play Protect or Advanced Protection may forbid installing apps from outside a store.
The update conflicts with the installed app: it is signed with another key, or it is older.
This device cannot run the new version: its Android version or its processor is not supported.
Android found the update file invalid.
Not enough free storage to install the update.
The confirmation was not answered in time.
The update could not be installed.
The update was not installed: Android asked to confirm it, and it was not confirmed.
Samsung Auto Blocker may be blocking app installs: Settings → Security and privacy → Auto Blocker → off, then try again.
Free some storage, about 500 MB, then try again.
Lattice is built for 64-bit ARM phones (arm64-v8a) with Android 7 or newer. Trying again will not help on this device.
If this app was not installed from a Lattice release, uninstall it and install the release by hand; that signs you out.
Once, when Lattice first opens as a new version.
Tap “Update” to download and install it.
